correctness.rationale: The two-state generator independently gives the exact second-moment ODE with forcing 2(f prime minus 2 gamma) M1 + 4 f M1 prime + 2. Source mean passage asymptotics give the exact large-x forcing exponent. Monotone coupling and the flux divergence rule out finite second moments for D >= 1/3 beyond the turning point; source mean divergence covers D >=1. A quartic corrector W signs = x^4 plus/minus (2v/gamma)x^3 has uniform leading drift 4(3D-1)x^2, yielding a global Foster upper bound when D<1/3. The flux at infinity is zero by the resulting x^4 bound, fixing coefficient 1/[4(1-D)(1-3D)]. The inner invariant region admits a uniform negative-velocity trial, hence an exponential hitting-time tail. SymPy checker independently reproduces the algebra; no finite experiment is substituted for the analytic argument.

value.rationale: The new sharp variance-existence boundary divides the naturally occurring exterior search region into infinite-mean, finite-mean/infinite-variance, and finite-variance regimes, while the interior has all exponential moments. It provides an exact fourth-power asymptotic coefficient at large launch distances. These facts answer a motivated higher-moment question explicitly deferred by the cited log-potential MFPT work and quantify failure of mean-only performance to control search-time fluctuations.
